name: Atranorin
aliases: Parmelin, Antranoric acid, Atranoric acid, Atranorine, Parmelin acid, Usnarin, Usnarin acid
summary: Atranorin is a chemical substance produced by some species of lichen. It is a secondary metabolite belonging to a group of compounds known as depsides. Atranorin has analgesic, anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, antifungal, cytotoxic, antioxidant, antiviral, and immunomodulatory properties. In rare cases, people can have an allergic reaction to atranorin.
zhHansOther: 黑盤灰衣素, 黑茶渍素

pharmacology.en: It is a depside, two phenolic rings joined by an ester bridge. Laboratory work shows it damps down inflammatory signalling and has activity against bacteria and fungi, but how it acts in people is not established.
pharmacology.zh: 它屬於縮酚酸類，由兩個酚環以酯鍵相連。實驗室研究顯示它能抑制發炎訊號，並對細菌與真菌有活性，但在人體中的作用機制尚未確立。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它属于缩酚酸类，由两个酚环以酯键相连。实验室研究显示它能抑制发炎信号，并对细菌与真菌有活性，但在人体中的作用机制尚未确立。

uses.en: It is not a medicine. It is studied in the laboratory for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activity, and it is used by botanists as a chemical marker for identifying lichen species.
uses.zh: 它不是藥物。它在實驗室中因抗發炎與抗微生物活性而受到研究，植物學家也以它作為鑑定地衣物種的化學標記。
uses.zhHans: 它不是药物。它在实验室中因抗发炎与抗微生物活性而受到研究，植物学家也以它作为鉴定地衣物种的化学标记。

sideEffects.en: Its effects in people have not been studied. Lichen substances of this kind are known to cause allergic skin reactions in some people who handle them.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響未曾被研究。已知這類地衣物質會讓部分接觸者出現過敏性皮膚反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响未曾被研究。已知这类地衣物质会让部分接触者出现过敏性皮肤反应。

fact.en: It is made by lichens, which are not single organisms but partnerships between a fungus and an alga. Atranorin is one of the compounds that gives many lichens their pale grey-green colour.
fact.zh: 黑盤灰衣素由地衣製造，而地衣並非單一生物，而是真菌與藻類的共生體。它是讓許多地衣呈現淡灰綠色的化合物之一。
fact.zhHans: 黑盘灰衣素由地衣制造，而地衣并非单一生物，而是真菌与藻类的共生体。它是让许多地衣呈现淡灰绿色的化合物之一。
